meta_title: How Dossie Scans a TREC Contract in 8 Seconds — Dossie
meta_description: Upload any TREC contract and Dossie extracts every field automatically, then flags what's missing — signatures, initials, blank fields — instead of guessing.
deck: Upload any TREC contract. Dossie reads the whole thing in about 8 seconds — and tells you exactly what's still missing before your client does.

intro_html: Drop in a signed TREC contract — PDF or photo — and Dossie reads the whole thing: price, dates, parties, addenda, every field. No retyping, no re-keying deal terms from a scanned PDF into a spreadsheet.

steps.p: Drag in the executed contract. Any TREC form, any scan quality — a phone photo works as well as a clean PDF export.
Dossie extracts every field into the dossier automatically: sales price, effective date, option fee, financing type, parties, every addendum attached.
Missing signatures, missing initials, and blank required fields get marked "Needs review" — Dossie never assumes a page is complete just because it's present.
steps.p_html: Missing signatures, missing initials, and blank required fields get marked Needs review — Dossie never assumes a page is complete just because it's present.

callout: Dossie never guesses that a signature is there. If a page is missing an initial, it tells you before your client does.
cta_title: Stop re-keying contract data by hand.
cta_sub: Dossie scans, extracts, and flags every file the moment it's uploaded — built for Texas agents.

faq.q: What file types does Dossie's contract scan accept?
faq.a: PDF and common image formats (JPG, PNG) — including phone photos of a signed contract. Scan quality doesn't need to be perfect.

faq.q: What does Dossie flag as "Needs review"?
faq.a: Missing signatures, missing initials on individual pages, and blank required fields. Dossie surfaces these instead of silently treating the contract as complete.
